cases.detail: Package feeds are strings, but SemVer components are numbers. Versions like 1.10.0 must sort after 1.9.9 even though lexical ordering says otherwise.
cases.title: numeric ordering

cases.detail: A yanked release can stay visible for lockfile reproducibility, but new resolution should skip it unless a future policy explicitly pins it. The current resolver never pins yanked versions.
cases.title: yanked releases

cases.detail: Caret ranges are common in ecosystem manifests. The allowed upper bound is sensitive to leading zero components, so 0.2.x and 0.0.x behave differently from 1.x.
cases.title: caret ranges

cases.detail: Release candidates should not appear in ordinary stable ranges. They become eligible only when a constraint operand itself mentions a pre-release version.
cases.title: pre-release opt-in

cases.detail: Resolution should evaluate all constraints first, then choose the maximum SemVer candidate. Early return behavior can pick a lower version by accident.
cases.title: highest satisfying candidate

notes: These notes are not executed directly; the unittest suite is the scorer.
They are included so agents can practice selecting relevant context.
A correct implementation should be deterministic across repeated runs.
title: Semver Resolver
